verdict.rationale: Qdrant ships both a lightweight local Docker instance for dev (qdrant-docs-1/16) and 'Qdrant Edge', an explicitly embedded, in-process, no-network-required engine for kiosks/mobile/robots (qdrant-docs-10/14), and community reports confirm an easy in-memory/sqlite-like POC mode for local development (qdrant-comm-4). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of Qdrant Edge specifically (it's a newer offering) and explicit documentation of the Python client's embedded ':memory:' mode in the evidence pack.
